title: LibScript TPU & XPK Accelerator Variables
description: Domain-scoped configuration variables for Google Cloud TPU VMs, XPK GKE clusters, and ML inference/training workloads.

LIBSCRIPT_TPU_ZONE.description: GCP compute zone for TPU VM or XPK cluster provisioning.

LIBSCRIPT_TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: Cloud TPU accelerator topology SKU (e.g., v4-8, v5litepod-4, v6e-1).

LIBSCRIPT_TPU_VERSION.description: Cloud TPU runtime OS image version (e.g., tpu-ubuntu2204-base, v2-alpha-tpuv5-lite, v2-alpha-tpuv6e).

LIBSCRIPT_TPU_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE.description: Tensor parallelism degree across TPU cores for model serving.

LIBSCRIPT_GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID used for TPU VM or XPK cluster operations.

LIBSCRIPT_XPK_CLUSTER_NAME.description: Target GKE cluster name managed via XPK.

LIBSCRIPT_MODEL_NAME.description: Model repository identifier (e.g., HuggingFace repo ID) served or benchmarked on accelerators.

LIBSCRIPT_WORKLOAD_NAME.description: Scheduled XPK or batch training workload identifier.
